authorization: User explicitly selected the original plan quality thresholds and source-localization checks in place of literal content parity after reviewing the v1 failure. Preserve v1 unchanged. This is a new protocol adopted after v1 observations, not a v1 passing result.

scope.backendCheck: Three originally frozen scientific pages, original official PyTorch MPS BF16 plus MLX BF16 and MLX 8bit, each scored against the same upstream annotations. This is a small independent implementation check, not an independent full-cohort reference.
scope.quantizationCheck: All 347 frozen scientific images, original MLX BF16 versus MLX8bit, each against upstream annotations. No page exclusions.
separateRequirements: existing PDF-to-image geometry tests including rotations/crop transforms
P4 evidence provenance and invalid-page refusal
scope.knownPdfImageMismatch: Retain slice144; do not reuse its masked-image gold for complete-PDF content claims.

content.text: Use unchanged scoring.json normalization, family mapping, insertion/deletion-inclusive microCER; report WER without inventing an additional threshold.
content.formulaTable: Use unchanged official matcher/CDM/TEDS with audited gold identities and nonempty gold glyph renderings. Compare scores against annotations, not reference-output strings.
content.invalidOutput: Retain invalid pages in every denominator as empty predictions; candidate invalid-page count must not exceed reference; no repair or hidden retry.

geometry.matching: Use unchanged scoring.json one-to-one maximum IoU per category family at IoU>=0.5, all mapped nonignored gold polygons retained.
geometry.coordinates: Gold polygon bounds divided by source page width/height; prediction integers divided by1000; no clipping, offset correction or box repair.
geometry.zeroFamilyGold: report not applicable only if no gold in the fixed cohort; never drop a family with gold or hallucinated predictions

readingOrder.metric: Pairwise inversion count among distinct, finite numeric gold orders using the same geometry matches, including every category with explicit order; gold order ties excluded; prediction order is raw block index.
readingOrder.coverage: Matched explicit-order gold / all explicit-order gold; missing matches remain in the coverage denominator.
readingOrder.upstreamReadingOrder: diagnostic only due known perfect-table fixture defect; never substitute its metric

qualification.evaluatorFailureOrMissingGold: invalidate run; never treat as model score
qualification.literalContentDiff: retain diagnostic evidence; no longer an adoption gate under explicit user authorization
qualification.applicationEnablement: Only after actual v2 quality, worker, source mapping and P4 product contracts pass; no switch based on configuration alone
